title: chtypes v1 conformance cases
description: The case table every enrolled binding's conformance runner executes, as the fixtures/server/parity lane will write it under tests/fixtures/fetch-v1/ (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §10, once that lane fills it in).

source.description: Provenance of the generator run that produced this file, so a stale checkout is detectable without re-running the generator.

tree.description: The route-tree/layout name under tests/fixtures/fetch-v1/trees/ or layouts/ this case runs against.

http_script.description: The id of an http-script fixture (tests/fixtures/fetch-v1/http/<id>.json) for the http transport, or null when the http transport serves the tree unscripted.

cache.description: "empty", or the name of a pre-seeded cache fixture.

lock.description: The name of an input lock fixture under locks/, or null.

before_index_rename_hook.description: The name of a race hook the runner installs before the cache's index.json atomic rename (e.g. index-race-reapply), or null.

trust.description: Which trust list the runner configures: the default release key, or the fixture test key (opt-in, see test-key/README.md).

bases.description: Base URL templates; `{base}` expands per transport (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §2).

own_fingerprint.description: The dev channel's alias step (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §3): a fixture ABI fingerprint, 64 lowercase hex, the runner hands its binding's alias seam, so a version request resolves `<tag>--fp-<this>` before `<tag>`. null runs the case with no alias step, as the v1 contract and every production channel do.

env.description: Extra environment variables the runner sets for this case only, beyond what `request` already implies.

sleeps.description: The exact sequence of injected sleep(seconds) calls a retrying fetch must make.

lock_after.description: The name of an expected-lock fixture under locks/ this case's resulting lock file must equal, or null when the case does not write a lock.

tags.description: For a `list-tags-` case (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §10), the published tags the binding's listing must return, in order: the tree's tags/list less every alias. null for every other case.

records_intact.description: Installed manifests whose cache directory (unpacked/sha256/<hex>/, every file in it) must be byte for byte the same after the call as before it: another ABI fingerprint's build in a cache the dev channel shares (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §3). The runner snapshots each after its pre-install step and compares after the call.
